newsitem.title: IRAN: Military plane with 86 aboard crashes in Iran.
newsitem.headline: Military plane with 86 aboard crashes in Iran.

text.p: An Iranian military plane with 86 people on board crashed in a mountainous region in northeastern Iran and there was no news of survivors, Iranian state media said on Friday.
The C-130 transport plane crashed 39 km (24 miles) from the city of Mashhad on Thursday, the official news agency IRNA said.
State-run Tehran radio said the pilot reported engine failure before the plane disappeared in mountains near Neyshabour, 75 km (47 miles) west of Mashhad.
Search teams had been sent but had not yet found wreckage of the plane, which was flying to Mashhad from Dezful in southwestern Iran, the radio said.
IRNA said the control tower at Mashhad airport lost contact with the plane at 6 p.m. local time (1430 GMT) on Thursday. It gave no further details.
Earlier this month, four Iranians were killed when a light military transport plane on a relief mission to Iran's quake-stricken northwest crashed in bad weather.
